en: A cleaner Settings layout: everything lines up and nothing gets cut off.
New Notifications settings: pick a colour and a sound for each kind of pop up, or turn the sound off.
Time zones: hover a zone and type a time, like 2pm, to see what it is for you.
Dynamic Island: give it any background colour, and click the small grey line at the top to hide it for 5 seconds.
Name the app whatever you like in Settings, under Mac settings.
Connect your own Supabase: PS can now set itself up inside a project you already use. It keeps to its own separate part and leaves your tables, data and users alone.
Access tokens limited to one project now work. If PS cannot list your projects, paste your project's address instead.
Not signed in yet? PS now offers new versions with an Update now card, so you never need to download it from the website again.
Meetings panel: see your upcoming meetings from your Mac's Calendar app, with the Dynamic Island switch and meeting settings right there.
Do Not Disturb is here: one button quiets pop ups while you focus.
Daily reminder: a card checks in once a day until you confirm. Write your own question for it in Settings.
Time zones: scroll over a time, or use the up and down arrow keys, to change it.
Hold Tab and let go, and the list now stays open. Hold Tab again to hide it. You can turn this off in Settings.
Time zones: add anyone with their time zone, and search a name to jump straight to where they are.
G Squad: start a squad with friends, see who is working right now, share and hand over tasks, and chat. All end to end encrypted.
Leaderboards for money, tasks and screen time, plus gym boards, personal bests and compare any exercise with your squad.
Fitness: your own rest times and sets, finish an exercise early, a sleep log, and Sleep mode with a big clock and alarms.
A new setup menu explains every setting in plain words, and updates now show right in your list.
Edit mode to move and hide panels and the Dynamic Island, PS fits any screen, plus colour backgrounds and rain.
Time zones by city, country or CET, type P1 to P3 when adding a task, Headphones mode, and Tab over every app.
Holding Tab is never dead without a reason: if macOS blocks keys (Secure Input), a permission is missing or PS is waiting for you to sign in, PS now tells you and shows the fix.
Sleep mode: Wake up always works, and the unlock prompt shows in front of the sleep screen.
Esc always backs you out, on every screen, Sleep mode included.
See available squads: The G Squad is listed. Tap Ask to join and the squad admin approves you.
The G Squad button now always shows, in one tidy row at the top of your list.
Sleep mode: customise the clock, add a stopwatch, the pointer hides when you leave the mouse alone, and take a short break when you wake up.
Fitness: a picture and a moving figure for every exercise.
Choose when your tasks reset, for example 4am instead of midnight.
A shorter setup menu, and every appearance option now previews properly and changes colour as you pick.
G Squad looks like a messenger now, with a Fitness section, maximise and minimise. Task sharing is off until you switch it on, and you can rename the squad and yourself.
Reply to client emails right in PS: your signature, quick replies, and send now or at a random time a few minutes later.
Settings has a search bar and simple groups, and every button shows what it does when you hover over it.
Fitness is simpler: one menu, today's workout first. Timelines open big with birthdays, weddings and more.
Sleep mode: more fonts and colours, a clock face, Wake me up in, and new wake styles.
Do Not Disturb focus modes, sparkly mouse trails, rename any time zone, and no more accidental text highlighting.
Keep everything on this Mac or phone: use PS with no account and no Supabase. Turn on sync later and nothing is lost, and Export my data now works for every account.
PS in your browser: the website's To-do page is now the full Tab list. Add friend in Settings shows a QR code a friend scans to join or ask to join your G Squad.
Fitness History: a calendar of your sleep and workouts, the month in numbers, charts, and Export with Copy for Claude, CSV or JSON.
Alarms: pick your own sound, set how loud it rings and test it. The built in sounds are no longer quiet.
The transparency slider is back at the top of your list, and you can pick the Overdue card's colour, text colour and effect in Settings.

Hold Tab to open PS over any app, Signal and 1Password included, even when locked. Fixes: the list no longer piles up after Tab, and the Dynamic Island moves to the side in full screen and never shows a stuck Working task.
Annoying 15 min reminder: add as many reminders as you like, each with its own words, times, buttons, colour and sound, on the Mac and the phone.
Auto reboot: the restart helper now stays switched on through updates.
G Squad: one squad for everyone, The G Squad. Tap Ask to join. It now opens full screen like a messenger, with bigger chat, simpler settings and its own looks.
Phone app: a tidier menu with Screen time, Timelines, Goals and Time zones, simpler Settings, smoother Fitness, and backgrounds of its own you can crop.
Fitness: a quick setup that saves as you go, an (i) on every setting explaining it, a clear menu button, and type any rest time.
New: a Soundboard for your audio and video, alarm playlists with a different sound each day, and alarms that ring even without Sleep mode.
Your list: Complete all, Resurrect is back, Sleep sits at the bottom right, and Time zones fit any screen zoom with a Create event button.
Settings: Tab overlay shortcuts with any key or combo, Add Telegram Bot, and simpler Sleep settings with a pinned preview.
New: Sentry mode. Press the AI button to lock your Mac while it stays fully awake, even on battery, so long jobs keep running.
The screen goes very dim to save power. Touch anything and it shows Protected by PS. Only Touch ID or your password gets you back in.
If nobody unlocks it within 8 hours, your Mac restarts by itself into its most secure state. Change the time in the AI button's gear.
Optional: keep your Mac awake with the lid closed, with a safety stop at low battery or high heat.
The app is now called PS app.
The G Squad is now automatic: everyone with PS app is in it, no codes or asking to join.
Setting up is much simpler: PS app opens each Supabase page for you, shows you where to click, and comes back by itself when your token is copied.
New accounts only need a passphrase. No name or username to fill in.
Sentry mode: hover over Dim Screen to save battery, and the screen comes back the moment you move away.
Update pop-ups now appear at the top centre, and the Meetings panel keeps its layout before you link a calendar.
The left column is back at the bottom left: the Meetings panel and its buttons sit where they always did.
Fixed: the "Restart helper is on" message no longer stays on screen, and the Soundboard name fits inside its button.
The restart helper fixes itself after an update. No more switching PS app off and on in System Settings.
Update now always installs the newest version in one go.
About and updates is now at the top of Settings, and the update check button is a reload symbol.
Sleep mode has an AI Sentry button: one click keeps your Mac protected and locked while you sleep, with its own 18 hour restart timer.
Sentry mode now checks that auto restart is working before it starts, and tells you how to fix it if not.
The helper steps now say to switch PS app off and on again if it already looks on.
Skipped a few updates? What's new now shows everything from every version you missed.
No more heat warning when you first use Sentry mode.
Sentry mode: keeping your Mac awake with the lid closed now really works, and Dim Screen turns the screen fully black while you hover over it.
Sentry mode now warns you before it starts if FileVault is off, with a button that opens the FileVault settings.
Keep overlay and Hover mode now slide out of the Dynamic Island's way, nothing on screen covers anything else, and the googly eyes look is gone.
What's new now catches you up from any older version, and the Settings background no longer flickers between dark and light.
Link your iPhone by scanning a code on your Mac, and the iPhone app now shows you how to save it to your Home Screen.
Get a card when a Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or Cursor chat finishes. Turn it on in Settings, Notifications.
PS app now checks for updates every 5 minutes. Pick 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes in Settings, About and updates.
Sentry mode checks the lid before it starts: if keeping your Mac awake with the lid closed will not work, it tells you why and how to fix it.
The Sentry screen no longer shows lid text, and Sentry mode no longer says the restart helper is off when you have just switched it on.
New: more to-do lists. Swipe with two fingers to move between pages, with dots at the bottom like an iPhone, and give each page its own background and look.
New: Edit zooms out to show all your pages. Add pages on either side, move any panel or button between pages, add as many panels as you like and resize them.
New: put an annoying reminder on any task. Right click it or edit it, pick the times and how often it repeats, and tick Done right from the reminder.
Notifications and reminders now come out of the Dynamic Island. Choose island or top right for each kind in the Dynamic Island settings.
AI chat finished cards now go away by themselves after 15 seconds. Change the time or turn it off in Settings.
Rename any list or section, and quick tips show you the new tricks. Swipe to tick and delete and the Notebook looks are gone.

New: your AI can manage your tasks. Turn on the AI task API in Settings, press Copy for AI, and paste it into Claude Code or Codex. Tasks it adds land in your AI Inbox in Dimension X, and it can start Sentry mode once you allow it.
New: Auto approve says Yes to your AI's permission prompts so long jobs keep going. Pick AI mode, Sleep mode or always in Settings. Questions still wait for you.
New: edit your phone's layout from your Mac. Press the phone icon in Edit and your changes glide across live. Your phone has its own Edit mode too, and a QR code links it if it isn't linked yet.
Edit overview: click a page to fly into it, click the background to go back, drag to move around, save looks you like and reset to the default, all with new sounds.
Finished AI chats now share one bubble, each with its own timer and the real chat name, and stay 10 seconds. Fixed: PS app no longer freezes when a reminder pops up.
The island glides to the top left in full screen apps, private mode is easy to spot and switch off, the tick circle stays on the left, and Dimension X manages your list pages.
New: alarms at any time. Your phone rings like an alarm at the times you pick, and you choose what the alarm screen says, just like the 15 minute reminders.

Gym nag mode: from 10:00 PS reminds you every 15 minutes until you press Yes, I'm going. Set your own ring time, gym times can go past midnight, and your AI can change your gym times through the API (it can never say Yes for you).
Completed tasks: scroll to the bottom to see every task you have finished, and Cmd + click tasks to bring back only the ones you pick.
Fixed: a finished AI chat no longer keeps popping up again and again.

Phone: link it faster by scanning one QR code, a smoother edit view with a Delete page button, drag with your mouse, and a bigger phone icon. Clicking a page in Edit on the Mac now keeps your list open.
Privacy: PS now asks GitHub for updates instead of cincee.com, it no longer stores your IP address when you sign in, and The G Squad is invite only.
Private mode: pop-ups now play no sound and shrink to a small note that hides what they say, until you click it.
Typing P1 to P4 while editing a task now sets its priority, just like when you add one.
Buttons in the task editor now change only when you click them, not when your mouse passes over them.
Invert swipe: flip which way you swipe between pages in Settings, Controls, or just ask your AI to do it for you.
Time zones: click to keep them open, so a page can show all your time zones at once.
Time converter: it now checks your calendar and tasks and tells you if you're free for a one hour meeting at that time, and what's in the way if not.
Pomodoro timer: a new button in the Tab overlay. Set your own work and break times, and during a break the island turns into a countdown, then shows a green tick and "Now back to work".
Stand-up reminders: PS reminds you to stand up. In the last 15 seconds a small tab on the island counts you down, then the island shows a little man standing for as long as you choose.
Next meeting on the island: a small bubble counts down to your next meeting, turns into a Join button in the last 2 minutes, and shows the time left while it runs.
Island: drag it into the black bar at the top of the screen and right into the corners, or let it sit in the top bar whenever an app is full screen.
Right click the island's grey bar for Settings, or to hide the island until your meeting ends or for a time you pick.
Island settings now open in a wider, neater window, and live in their own Dynamic island tab in Settings.
Smoother page swipes: the page follows your fingers and settles gently, and buttons no longer jump along and vanish.
Tab and the island now work over 1Password and Signal, and a bug that sometimes stopped Tab opening over them is fixed.
PS is now built by more than one person: friends can add features with their own AI, every release says who made it, and in Settings, From the squad, you choose which shared features you get.

AI messages: Claude Code, Codex and other AIs on your Mac can now send you a short message on the island when they finish, instead of just saying the chat is done. Switch it on and copy the instructions in Settings, AI task API.
Setting up PS: the island now pops out of the setup screen and walks you through every step, with a green tick and a chime each time you get one right.
Phone island: on your phone, a small live island around the camera shows over every app: your next meeting, Pomodoro breaks, stand-ups, reminders and AI messages. Tap it to open PS.
Faster phone notifications: client emails, AI messages and finished chats now arrive within seconds instead of up to 15 minutes.
Scan a machine: in a workout, point your phone at a machine's label, even in German, and PS finds the exercise, adds it to your workout and shows how it is done. The picture stays on your phone.
Comments on sets: after a set, add a short note like 'seat at 4' and see it later in your workout history.
New exercise: Abs cable crunch, with its own little figure.
Reply in the email panel: write a reply right in the email card on your phone, the website or your Mac, with a few seconds to undo.
Stand-up reminders are now on for everyone and show big in the middle of the island. The first time, PS asks if you want them off.
The next meeting bubble on the island now always shows its full time.
Completed tasks open on the last 24 hours, with More at the bottom for the rest.

Screen recording: record sales and client calls from the new button under your email panel, or say Yes when the island asks at a meeting. Your mic and the call are saved on two tracks, can upload to your own cloud, and play back in the Soundboard. Off until you switch it on.
WhatsApp replies: link your own WhatsApp number in Settings and client messages show as cards and in the email panel, with Reply and quick replies. It needs your own Meta app and a second number.
Client emails for everyone: switch it on in Settings and your clients' Gmail emails and Instantly replies show as cards and in the email panel, with Reply. Each email notifies only once.
Did you know: the island now shows you big new features a little while after you start using PS, with a short guide.
G Squad messages pop up as a card you can reply to right from the card, with a few seconds to undo.
G Squad has a new, calmer messenger look. Switch back any time in Squad settings, Appearance.
Mac island: one card at a time, cards drop out with a squeeze and a bounce, and the island says 'Updated to V1.60' after an update.
Mac island: your meeting countdown is a small blob, the island says Welcome back with your tasks after you were away, and shows a summary after a workout.
Phone reminders now ring like an alarm, even with PS closed, and show full screen in the iPhone web app.
The phone island follows your workout: it shows the exercise it found, counts down your rest and tells you when you lifted more than last time.
Gym scan reads real machine labels, even sideways, and there is a Scan button in every exercise search. New sets start at the weight and reps you used last.
Phone fixes: page dots like the iPhone's, a readable update card, and full screen panels that clear the status bar.
Mac island: the meeting name and time are now big and easy to read.
Mac island: click the email count to open that email in your Tab list. The count only shows when Client emails is on.
Fixed: the 'Database loaded' tick and the other new 1.60 features now come on properly on the Mac, the phone and the website.
After an update, the Dock shows the new PS logo straight away.
The email panel now shows for everyone. Connect your Gmail from the panel to see your clients' emails.
Every new feature from 1.60 is now on for everyone. Switch any of them off in Settings, From the squad.
Build PS with friends: click Link my AI in Settings, G Squad, and your AI can talk to your friends' AIs, share progress and release updates.
New app logo
Squad Priority 1: your squad sees each other's Priority 1 tasks, with 24 hours to finish. Hide any task, or turn it off.
G Squad messages now come out of the Dynamic Island, with Reply.
G Squad has a slimmer look, with emoji and reactions.
Pick which calendars count as meetings, and connect Gmail with one 'Copy for your AI' button.
Fixes: drag a task onto Priority 1 to make it Priority 1, Looks Preview shows your real list for 5 seconds, and PS stops asking to update Supabase on every launch.
Reply to any G Squad message, even old ones, the same way as Signal.
Click the people at the top of G Squad to see who is online, who is at the gym, and when the others were last seen.
Past boards: the squad's leaderboards from December 2025 to July 2026 are now in the Leaderboard.
Rewind: PS now keeps a private, encrypted history of your year for a recap on 1 January. You can turn it off in Settings.
Fixes: Timelines cards no longer pile on top of each other.
Activity monitor: see what is using your Mac, live, in a new screen next to Network.
Speak your tasks: talk, and PS turns it into tasks, on your Mac only.
Type dates naturally: 'call David Friday 3pm' sets the day, the time and a reminder.
Time estimates: PS learns how long your tasks take and tells you when your day is too full.
Settings assistant: tell the island what you want, and it changes the setting and shows you where it lives.
Low power mode: one leaf button puts background work to sleep and keeps your list running.
Receipts: scan a receipt on your phone and see your spending in the new Purchases screen. It all stays on your devices.
Posture and checklist reminders, and a different background for each device.
G Squad looks like Signal now, with private messages, group chats and profile pictures.
Notifications stack into one card, Proton Mail joins Client emails, and a short tour shows what is new.
Also: skip just tomorrow's alarm, set your speaker and microphone order, and the middle click now fixes itself.
Phone: an Add task button now sits at the bottom right of every page.
Phone: PS has its own island at the top, and screens no longer hide under the status bar.
Phone: swiping inside Numerology and other open screens no longer flips the page behind them.
Hover the island during an upcoming meeting and the meeting stays in view; right click it to hide that meeting.
New to G Squad? PS now asks if you want to join.
The AFK timer asks the first time if you want it, like the posture reminder.
Fixes: the Purchases button opens again on the Mac, and Settings shows who made PS.
Hatch: after an update, PS builds its icon, cracks it open and hatches your island.
A short version plays every time PS opens. Esc skips it, or turn it off in Settings, Dynamic Island.
The Dynamic Island is on for everyone again. Turn it off for good in Settings.
Phone: hold the round button bottom left for the wheel menu. Every screen opens full screen.
Receipts read more accurately.
Your pages, panels and settings stay where you put them after an update. The Edit button stays visible while you arrange.
Squad Priority 1 shows one row per person: time left, hit rate and streak. Hover any number to see what it means.
One G Squad for everyone, no more Leave or Join. Your sleep now reaches the squad even if you skip Save.
Streaks on every mini task of a repeating task. Add a reminder and an estimate while adding a task.
Dimension X: drag tasks between lists, move anything to Ideas, and moves never leave a copy behind.
Private mode turns itself off when the meeting ends. The island's email count matches your email panel.
The update animation now flies your island to wherever you keep it.
Replay the update animation any time in Settings, About and updates.
With your island low on the screen, What's new and new feature cards open in the middle.
Middle click recovers by itself after macOS pauses it, also right after an update.
PS only takes updates signed the same way as the copy you have, so your permissions stay put.
A countdown under your headline shows how much of your day is left. Change it in Settings, Countdown text.
At zero it asks 'End day now?', and the island can remind you how much time is left.
Each Priority 1 task shows how long is left of its 24 hours.
The buttons at the top right now live in one menu, and Pomodoro moved into Edit.
A new sign in picture, also in Backgrounds as 'Neon city'.
If holding Tab does nothing, the island tells you which app has the keyboard and how to fix it.
